samples.question: On a white square canvas a scattered set of small dark dots is drawn. Take the exact center point of the square canvas. Looking at all the dots together as one constellation, do they surround that center point -- meaning the center of the canvas lies inside the region enclosed by the dots -- or do all the dots sit to one side of it? Answer yes if the dot constellation encloses the exact center of the square canvas, or no if every dot lies on the same side of that center.
